# Parse files and reorganize
import os

base_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings_files/'
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files')

# Collect unique file names (without extension) to create directories
file_names = set()
for f in files:
    basename = os.path.basename(f)  # e.g., "2023-apr-03__slides.ppt"
    # Split on "__"
    date_part, rest = basename.split('__', 1)
    # Split rest on last dot to get file_name and extension
    file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    file_names.add(file_name)

# Create directories for each file_name
for fn in file_names:
    dir_path = base_dir + fn
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True)

print("Directories created:", file_names)

# Move each file to the new structure
import os

base_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings_files/'
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files')

for f in files:
    basename = os.path.basename(f)
    date_part, rest = basename.split('__', 1)
    file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    dest_dir = base_dir + file_name

    print(f"Moving {f} -> {dest_path}")
    apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=f, destination_file_path=dest_path)
